notes.title: Extra Replenish & UI/UX changes
notes.notes:
Now you always have an options to skip an upgrade in exchange for 2 usages of your main attack actions back. (upgrades are almost always the better choice though!)
 Changed some of the text boxes to be a bit bigger to allow for easier reading

notes.title: Quick stability update (May 29th, 2023)
notes.notes:
Fixed a crash that could occur after selecting a target / pathing destination
 Combat log should always show replenish now

notes.title: Release Update!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to be releasing Rerun today! Most of the work has been just getting "things ready" for release. Here are a few of the in-game things I've been working on this last month in preparation:


Content updates:

 The Pained Knight is a new miniboss who is very dangerous.
 Reworked about 40 existing levels, added 10 new ones!
 Added little cutscenes for when your adventurers die.
 Changed Thorn Armor so it also deals aoe damage on cast.
 Changed Ice Wall to be a bonus action.


Usability updates:

 Full controller support!
 A menu that shows you controller & keyboard mappings.
 Tweaked all the screen-wide casting effects to be a bit snappier, and clean. (You can still disable them in the options menu).
 Sounds are no longer deafening, hurray! (and sorry).
 The generated dungeon map always has at least 2 paths to give the player more choice and allow them to avoid upgrades they don't want.
 Quick action menu (Right Click) now can't clip off the top of the screen.

notes.title: Progression & Sawblade Update!
notes.notes:
Content updates:

 Added a new hazard, the "Loose Sawblade", it bounces around the level giving you more ways to out maneuver your foes! (Or lose track of them and end up dead).
 Updated every level in the demo with a Sawblade (if I thought it'd make the level better.. it usually did)
 Added a couple new levels inspired by the Sawblade
 In the full game, there are now Ultimate Abilities, unique per character, enter the Mystery Room to find one!


Usability updates:

 Mini-tutorial for initial level
 Cursor will now show a red (/) when you're trying to select an invalid target
 Cleaned up the UI for ability selection and added a little "Select Ability" call to action above it
 You should be able to see your upgrades on /every/ screen now.
 Controller is fully supported (just not documented.. yet =])
 Options menu is available from every screen (if you see it missing, lemme know)

notes.title: NextFest Feedback Update 1
notes.notes:
Added helpful chat bubbles where adventurers now help first time players a bit.
 When using the mouse, click to drag is now your only way to move your adventurers. This means you should no longer get an auto generated path through lava, unless that is your actual intent!
 Updated chat bubbles to be a bit cleaner. Before they would sometimes chop off punctuation marks.
 The intro cutscene should no longer blink.
 Fixed some text color mishaps.
 Fixed blinking stat tags when you get the game over screen.


Lots more to come but I'm hoping the first two help reduce friction a bit for first time players.

If you have any questions, comments, bugs, suggestions, or whatever! Feel free to reach out on the Discord, Steam's Community Hub, or my twitter.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update (Demo)
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that was affecting AMD gpu users!
 Added drag & drop as an option to move your adventurers.
 Added a "quick action" panel that pops up beside your adventurer (when right clicked) this is useful for when you already know what action you want to use.
 Added casting fx to enemy casters.
 Added "Casts in X Turns" to enemy caster's stat tag.
 Changed "The Plan" screen to be a little more clear and a little less annoying for mouse users =]
 The Combat Log now shows who has recived items (and from who/what).
 Now when you try to path over Firetraps or Lava, you'll get a popup warning you.
 Tried to make the auto-pather when selecting a path a bit less strict, hopefully its better!
 Tried to make Toughguy's "Pull" action more clear when there are units/objects that could be pulled but are not in your line of sight. Or I just make it more confusing.. we'll see.


If you have any questions, comments, bugs, suggestions, or whatever! Feel free to reach out on the Discord, Steam's Community Hub, or my twitter.

Thanks for playing!
